contentList.content: While not wearing armour, you add your Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Modifier</LSTag> to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag>, up to a maximum of +4. You also cannot be knocked <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag> or forcibly moved by a foe's spells or actions.
If a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes [1]. (Once per turn.)
